title: discovery.py: actual_hops calculation assumes INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT start value
description: Line 134: actual_hops = max(0, INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT - rreq.hop_limit) assumes all RREQs start with INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT (10). But originate_rreq (line 98) allows custom hop_limit for expanding ring search. If RREQ originates with hop_limit=5, first receiver computes actual_hops=5 when real hop count is 0, corrupting reverse route metrics.
